items.title: Mrs. Mary Lucy Hamill O'Kelly Interview, 1958-05-04
items.q: I think it, that probably was the Dixie Lane Jazz Band now, don't you think?

ctx.x: No, I don't know what band it was. It was the Halfway House. The Halfway House, and I think it, that probably was the Dixie Lane Jazz Band now, don't you think?
It's called the Halfway House Orchestra.
